notes: FlexRay does not define OTP/fuse content as a protocol concept. The schedule, slot assignment, timing, and sync/coldstart role are host-programmed configuration parameters (g*/p*) loaded in the CONFIG state; an implementation may back some defaults with non-volatile storage, but the spec only requires they be configurable.

otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.note: Whether the node is a sync node and/or a coldstart node; configured, not protocol-fixed.
The static slot in which the node sends its sync/startup key frame.
Static-slot count/length, minislot count/length, cycle length, payload length — identical cluster-wide.
Single vs dual channel; which of A/B the node uses.
